faq.refferal2: Will I get any reward for inviting friends?
faq.refferal_ans2:
Of course! We generously reward those who invite new friends to our project.

You will receive 10% in three levels (5%-3%-2%) from each purchase made by your referral.
faq.refferal_ans1: Yes, on the Friends page you can invite your friends and see all referral stats there.
faq.balance3: How long does deposit and withdrawal take?
faq.balance_ans3: Deposits and withdrawals in TON are instant. It usually takes no more than 30 seconds.
faq.balance_ans2:
Go to the Balance page, enter your wallet and press MAX

Minimum withdrawal is 0.1 TON.
faq.balance1: How to top up the balance?
faq.balance_ans1: Simply go to the Balance page, connect your TON wallet or use the direct transfer via MEMO.
faq.what_civilization_ans3: To start, top up your Balance and buy your first Planet.
faq.what_civilization_ans2:
Yes, you earn rewards in TON while playing.

But remember, CivilizationTon is a game where all deposits are voluntary donations.
faq.what_civilization_ans: Civilization is a unique P2E game where you earn rewards in TON.
